# Manpreet Kaur, Freelance UI/UX Designer (UIUXFLOW)

> Manpreet Kaur is a freelance UI/UX designer based in Mohali, India, working with clients worldwide since 2021. She designs SaaS dashboards, e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce), landing pages and mobile apps in Figma, and works as a white-label design partner for agencies. Top Rated on Upwork with 100% Job Success.

Key facts:
- Name: Manpreet Kaur (brand: UIUXFLOW)
- Role: Freelance UI/UX designer and product designer, freelancing since 2021
- Location: Mohali, Punjab, India (IST, UTC+5:30); works with clients worldwide in English, Hindi and Punjabi
- Specialities: SaaS products and dashboards, e-commerce and Shopify stores, landing pages and conversion (CRO), mobile app design, design systems, animated heroes and Figma prototypes, UX audits
- Tools: Figma, FigJam, Adobe Photoshop, Framer, Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce
- Credentials: Google UX Design Professional Certificate; Bachelor's in Graphics & Web Designing, Guru Nanak Dev University
- Proof: Top Rated on Upwork, 100% Job Success, 5.0 average rating

## Blog: UI/UX guides

- [Website Redesign Checklist: 4 Things to Check First](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/before-website-redesign-checklist): Planning a website or app redesign? Check 4 things first: your data, users, goal and content. A short pre-redesign checklist that saves months.
- [4 Small Checkout UX Details That Cost You Sales](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/checkout-ux-details): Cart abandonment often comes down to small details. Fix 4 checkout UX issues: surprise costs, forced accounts, unclear errors and missing trust signals.
- [5 Signs Your Dashboard Is Confusing Users](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/confusing-dashboard-signs): Low usage, support tickets and data exports are clues your SaaS dashboard confuses users. Here are 5 warning signs and practical UX fixes for each.
- [Why Startups Need a Design System Early](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/design-system-early-startups): Design debt grows with every new screen. Why startups should start a lightweight design system early, what it costs and the smallest version worth building.
- [Figma Design System for Startups: When and How to Start](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/figma-design-system-for-startups): Does your startup need a Figma design system? Learn when it pays off, what to build first (tokens, components, patterns) and how to keep it simple.
- [5-Minute UX Audit: What a Designer Checks First](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/five-minute-ux-audit): Do a quick UX audit of your website or app in five minutes. The exact checks I run first: first impression, mobile, navigation, the main action and trust.
- [Freelance UI/UX Designer vs Agency: Which to Hire?](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/freelance-ui-ux-designer-vs-agency): Should you hire a freelance UI/UX designer or a design agency? An honest comparison of cost, speed, communication and quality, plus questions to ask first.
- [The 5-Second Test: What Your Landing Page Must Say](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/landing-page-5-second-test): Visitors decide in seconds. Use the 5-second test to check your landing page says what it is, who it is for, why it matters and what to do next.
- [10 Landing Page Fixes to Increase Conversions](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/landing-page-conversion-fixes): Improve landing page conversion rate with 10 practical UX fixes: clearer headlines, one CTA, social proof, faster load and better mobile layouts.
- [Mobile App Onboarding UX: Best Practices](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/mobile-app-onboarding-ux): Mobile app onboarding UX best practices: shorter sign-up, progressive permissions, personalised first screens and empty states that guide users to value fast.
- [SaaS Dashboard UI/UX Design: 9 Principles](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/saas-dashboard-design-principles): Dashboard UI/UX design principles for SaaS: hierarchy, empty states, filters, tables and charts, and how to turn complex data into a dashboard teams use.
- [SaaS Onboarding UX: Get Users to Their First Win Faster](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/saas-onboarding-first-win): Most SaaS trials are lost in the first session. Learn how to define the first win, remove setup friction and design onboarding that shortens time to value.
- [7 Signs Your Shopify Store Needs a Redesign](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/shopify-store-redesign-signs): Traffic but no sales? Here are 7 clear signs your Shopify store needs a redesign, plus what to fix first to lift conversions without starting from scratch.
- [5 Rules for Thumb-Friendly Mobile App Design](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/thumb-friendly-mobile-app-design): Most people use their phone with one thumb. These 5 mobile UX rules cover the thumb zone, tap target sizes, bottom navigation and gestures.
- [The UI/UX Design Process: Why UI Is Step 6](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/ui-design-process-step-6): Jumping straight to pretty screens is the most expensive way to design a product. Here is the 7-step UI/UX design process I use and why the UI comes sixth.
- [UX Audit Checklist: 25 Things to Check](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/ux-audit-checklist): A practical UX audit checklist for websites, SaaS products and apps: navigation, forms, mobile, accessibility, speed and conversion. 25 checks to run today.
- [White-Label UI/UX Design Partner: Guide for Agencies](https://uiuxflow.co.in/blog/white-label-ui-ux-design-partner): How white-label UI/UX design works for agencies: NDAs, branding, tools, pricing models and how to choose a partner who stays invisible to your clients.
